title: House-sized tall white deep spacecraft seen in person

tellings.quote: see how this house is one that I personally saw was a little bit longer than this house a little bit wider than this house about half again as high as this house

plain: In the 1960s, in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, Charles Hall says he saw with his own eyes a deep-space craft of the "Tall Whites", tall pale beings he says he lived alongside for three years near Area 51, a secret military test site in Nevada. He tells Michels the craft was about the size of a house, "a little bit longer than this house a little bit wider than this house about half again as high." If true, he saw an alien ship parked on American soil.
